# Angelia

> Angelia is a small local daemon that routes WhatsApp and Telegram chats to the coding agent CLI on the user's own Mac (supported: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and pi; OpenCode next). One chat, one profile folder, one session. It runs no model of its own. MIT license. This file describes version {{VERSION}}.

Install with `curl -fsSL {{SITE}}/install | sh` (it checks the release signature and starts `angelia init`), or with npm: `npm install -g --ignore-scripts angelia-gateway`, then `angelia init`. One file, `~/.angelia/workspace/routing.yaml`, maps chats to profiles. Scripts and programs on the same machine talk to a running daemon through a local HTTP API on a Unix socket, `~/.angelia/api.sock` (or `$ANGELIA_STATE_DIR/api.sock`), with the owner's token from `~/.angelia/api.token`. It never opens a network port. An agent that runs inside Angelia uses the `angelia` command; `angelia guide` is its manual, and `angelia guide api` covers the API.

## Docs

- [README]({{RAW}}/README.md): what Angelia is, install, quick start, chat commands, security in one minute, backends, FAQ
- [Reference]({{RAW}}/docs/reference.md): features in detail, capabilities per profile, setting things up by hand, the instance folder, every file Angelia keeps
- [Security model]({{RAW}}/docs/security.md): who can reach and command the agent, tokens, secrets, the sandbox, what leaves the machine
- [Docs on the site]({{SITE}}/docs/): the reference, security model, runbook and decisions as web pages, built from the repository's main branch; each page's Markdown is at its URL plus `index.md`

## Pages

- [Angelia for Claude Code: setup, approvals and limits]({{SITE}}/claude-code/): what Angelia does for Claude Code, setup, approvals, voice notes, files, limits
- [Your coding agent CLI on WhatsApp]({{SITE}}/whatsapp/): the second number, linking by QR, groups, what works, privacy, limits
- [Your coding agent CLI on Telegram]({{SITE}}/telegram/): the bot, groups and topics, what works, privacy, limits
- [Angelia vs OpenClaw and Hermes Agent]({{SITE}}/alternatives/): whose agent runs, chat apps, sessions, and when another tool fits better

## Local API

- [Build on Angelia]({{SITE}}/docs/api.md): tokens, a quick start, the stable routes, events, and the stability promise
- [OpenAPI 3.1 document]({{SITE}}/openapi.json): every route, field, error and example answer. A running daemon serves its own copy at `GET /openapi.json` on the socket, with no token
- [Example clients]({{TREE}}/examples/api): tested against a real daemon; Python with the standard library only, Node with no packages, and curl
